watermark.added: 2026-11-12 (owner request: burn the channel watermark into a corner of the video)
watermark.where: Burnt into the picture when the shot frames are encoded (tools/cli.py encode_sequence): chapter intermediates, the assembled film and review excerpts of every preset; never in the Blender renders, so the render cache is unaffected. Only for projects whose project.json says "watermark": true (films finished before it keep their verified intermediates).
watermark.why_bottom_left: Measured on the floating-city internal review (2026-11-12): the other three corners carry the film's own text (TOP_LEFT card tags and chapter titles, TOP_RIGHT and BOTTOM_RIGHT notes); the box sits inside the subtitle zone of config/annotation_style.json (bottom 17 %), which annotations never enter, and at the left edge of the title-safe area; YouTube's own channel watermark and end-screen subscribe element use the bottom right. Navy at 55 % stays readable over every background the film has (luma 118-218 under the box).
watermark.note: Source attribution, not protection against re-upload. The navy lockup is for light footage (watermarks_navy_revision.json).
